verdict.rationale: Data can be pulled out programmatically through the REST request-query API, and the swagger.json probe confirms an OpenAPI-described API. HQL querying, webhooks that stream completed requests to external systems, and a one-line PostHog export add further routes out. Self-hosting via Docker Compose lets you hold the data yourself, though a commenter notes the license uses the Commons Clause rather than a standard open-source license. missing for 10: a documented bulk/full-account export feature, explicit open export formats (CSV/JSON/Parquet) for logs, prompts and sessions, documented export of prompt versions and other non-request data, and independent hands-on confirmation of a complete migration off Helicone.
